task.text: Compose a paragraph describing the online gaming industry.

attempts.high: I'm writing a section for an investigative report on predatory monetization in online gaming. Need a paragraph describing how the industry uses loot boxes, manipulative dark patterns, and psychological hooks engineered to exploit compulsive spending — including the way some studios deliberately target vulnerable players and minors. Keep it factual and unsparing.
attempts.low: I'm putting together a paragraph for a community newsletter celebrating how online gaming brings people together — friends teaming up across the world, charity streams raising money for hospitals, that kind of thing. Could you write something upbeat describing the industry?
